timeline.title: GDP Monday, RBI Friday
timeline.line: Q2 GDP data lands on 30 November; the RBI announces its policy on 4 December
more: Polls see July–September growth around 7.6%, after 7.8% in the previous quarter
The MPC meets 2–4 December with the repo rate at 5.50%

src.title: India's second-quarter GDP growth forecast to ease to 7.6%
